en.answer:
If <<11965>> itself is in face-down Defense Position when the effect resolves, the『this card's ATK becomes 3000, and this card's name becomes "<<4370>>"』effect won't be applied.

Also, if <<11965>> is changed to face-down Defense Position with the effect of <<5432>> activated after the effect of <<11965>> has resolved, the『this card's ATK becomes 3000, and this card's name becomes "<<4370>>"』effect will stop applying.
en.question:
If <<5432>> is chained to the『You can send 1 "<<4370>>" monster from your hand to the Graveyard; until your opponent's next End Phase, this card's ATK becomes 3000, and this card's name becomes "<<4370>>"』effect of <<11965>> and <<11965>> is changed to face-down Defense Position, what happens to the resolution?

Also, if the effect of <<5432>> is applied after the『You can send 1 "<<4370>>" monster from your hand to the Graveyard; until your opponent's next End Phase, this card's ATK becomes 3000, and this card's name becomes "<<4370>>"』effect of <<11965>> has resolved, what happens?
en.title: If the effect of <<5432>> is applied to <<11965>>, what happens to its card name and ATK?

ja.answer:
「<<11965>>」自身が効果処理時に裏側守備表示になっている場合には、『攻撃力が３０００になり、カード名を「<<4370>>」として扱う』効果は適用されません。

また、「<<11965>>」の効果適用後に発動した「<<5432>>」の効果によって、「<<11965>>」が裏側守備表示になった場合には、『攻撃力が３０００になり、カード名を「<<4370>>」として扱う』効果の適用はなくなります。
